english.title: Participant/organiser of one person protest fail to comply with condition - Public Order Act
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having organised or carried on a one-person protest, failed to comply with a condition imposed under section 14ZA of the Public Order Act 1986, namely **(..SPECIFY CONDITION BREACHED..), when you knew or ought to have known that the condition had been imposed
english.legislation: Contrary to section 14ZA(10) and (14) of the Public Order Act 1986.

english.notes:
(i) This offence was introduced by section 79 of the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act 2022 and came into force on the 28th June 2022.
(ii) A defence is available under subsection (11) to prove that the failure arose from circumstances beyond the person's control.
